meta.basis: The Second Reading is proclaimed from the ambo by a reader, all seated and listening, with the same acclamation as the first (GIRM 130, 43); on Sundays it is from the Apostle, here Paul's First Letter to the Corinthians (Second Sunday, Year C), whence the carved St. Paul with his sword and book. The reader is a layman in ordinary dress, against the alb of the First Reading.
